claim: This video shows a real C-17 emergency landing in a farm field.
caption:
CLAIM: A circulating clip shows a C-17 making an emergency landing in a farm field.

EVIDENCE: Lead Stories traced the video to an earlier Instagram upload dated 16 March 2026 that explicitly disclosed AI creation. The clip resurfaced on X on 28 October. The fact-check also identified inconsistent aircraft markings and objects.

VERDICT: AI-generated video—not footage of that landing.

Source: Lead Stories, 29 October 2026
https://leadstories.com/hoax-alert/2026/10/fact-check-video-does-not-show-c17-globemasters-real-emergency-landing.html

AI illustration — not actual footage. This card uses original symbolic artwork, not a frame from the viral video.

#FactCheck #ClaimVsEvidence #MediaLiteracy

Checked 30 October 2026. AI-assisted research, design and original illustration; independent automated review.
evidence_summary: Does not assert aircraft cannot land on rough fields. AI detector output only supplementary. Original symbolic illustration, not footage or event reconstruction.
